note: H9's own soft lamp halo: white additive (the colour is each entity's rendercolor), a smooth radial falloff that reaches exactly 0 at 0.8 of the half-frame, so every pixel outside the inscribed circle is black and no square shows under Xash's gamma. Replaces TS's yelflare1/glow01 and HL's glow04 in the h9-byzantium dress, whose 'black' corners are 1-7 of 255. Build: node bin/smak.mjs sprite levels/art/h9-glow.sprite.json -o levels/art/h9 ; install levels/art/h9/sprites/h9_glow.spr as <H9>/ts/sprites/h9_glow.spr.
